title: The Static of the Kuiper Line Revisited
author: Wendell Oyelaran
blurb: Felix Pemberton, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
